title: Clean Nordic Tee & Blue Eyes

Her expression is calm and focused against a pale blue-gray seamless backdrop. Soft, even studio light with minimal shadow. Palette of pale blue, ivory, and soft rose. Clean and understated, in the style of a Nordic minimalist catalog.
workingNotes:
